Subdomain header allowlist entries must be valid HTTP header names

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

do {
    let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"subdomain_header_allowlist\":[\"invalid header name\"]}")
    let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
    let url = "https://example.com"
    _ = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
} catch {
    print("\(type(of: error)): \(error)")
}
```
